name: THE MINI GRAND PRIX
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: The map seats a MINI GRAND PRIX by the freeway (engine/bohemia_overmap.js, 'WATER PARKS: one by a freeway, one not; MINI GRAND PRIX by the freeway'): one cell, in 40 of 40 valleys. Las Vegas has had one since 1989: go-karts, a coaster, an arcade.

A family fun park is its arcade hall (rows of cabinets, the skee-ball lanes, air hockey, the token changers, the prize counter with its prize wall behind, the party room's tables) and its kart garage (the karts parked in rows, tyre walls, the mechanics' bench, the parts shelves, fuel cans, an oil slick by the pit).

On house tiles a row of cabinets, the prize wall and the parts shelves each hide a man; the skee-ball lanes are a low run nobody walks over and a man is seen across; water through the roof and an oil slick are Battle Brothers' swamp.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (minigp_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The park is its track and its coaster outside and its two buildings: half the fights at its cell are fought inside, in the arcade or the kart garage, by the cell's own dice; the rest on the track.
share_dice: THE MAP'S DICE (COMBAT FOUR 11/22): a place's inside is rolled from its cell (the same cell the same answer), so a place on a few cells goes inside on a step, never a slope: 'share' is the threshold its real cells need for 'share_meant' to come true over a whole run of valleys, measured on the map's own cells (gates/the_big_insides_gate.js I14). minigp: meant 0.5, went inside in 100% of its cells over 40 valleys (2 places, 39 cells, after what the parking garage takes first); at 0.33, 44%, the nearest its dice allow.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words); 'sight' says whether a blocker hides a man ('blocked', the obstacles row) or is seen past ('seen'). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The park's block wall, painted with a checkered flag: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The arcade's carpet, stars and planets worn to the backing; the garage's concrete: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

cabinets.effect: A row of arcade cabinets back to back, a few still glowing with an attract loop nobody plays, the same eight seconds over and over: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it; cover beside it. [bb] its wall.

prizes.effect: The prize wall behind the counter, stuffed animals faded to grey: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

skeeball.effect: The skee-ball lanes, a low run of ramps: nobody walks over them; a man is seen across them; cover beside them. [bb] its palisade you see through.

hockey.effect: An air hockey table tipped on its side: cover.

tables.effect: The party room's tables, a paper banner still taped to one: cover.

tokens.effect: A token changer, pried open and empty: cover.

stools.effect: Stools and a fallen sign: low cover.

kiosk.effect: The ticket kiosk at the door: cover.

shelves.effect: The parts shelves, floor to ceiling: nobody stands there, and nobody sees through it. [bb] its wall.

karts.effect: Go-karts parked nose to tail, a man crouches behind them: low cover.

bench.effect: The mechanics' bench, an engine in pieces on it: cover.

tyres.effect: A wall of old tyres from the track's edge: low cover. [bb] its palisade waist high.

cans.effect: Fuel cans for the karts: low cover.

water.effect: The monsoon came through the roof and stayed, standing on the carpet: slow going (4 AP), and a man standing in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
water.say: Standing water: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

oil.effect: An oil slick by the pit, slick as ice: slow going (4 AP), and a man standing in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
oil.say: An oil slick: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a drum. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The doors, open onto the track: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in minigp_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: the coaster is outside; nothing in the arcade or the garage is a climb under fire on house tiles.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the arcade's black ceiling with its dead neon, the garage's trusses, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the warehouse's roof).
